entry.name: AI for Everyone
entry.note: A non-technical course on what AI can and cannot do inside an organisation
entry.audience: Managers, executives and anyone working alongside technical teams

reading.format: Online course on Coursera; enrollment is free.
reading.summary: This course explains what AI is and what it can do. It gives an overview of key issues in AI and how results are achieved. Finishing it shows a basic understanding of AI concepts for non-technical people.
reading.audience: Non-technical colleagues and business leaders who want their organization to use AI better.
